description: This file defines a serializable Java class named 'Menu' used to represent menu items in a web application's admin interface. It includes properties such as code, url, icon, role, order, and a list of submenus.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: A class representing a menu item with properties for code, url, icon, role, order, and nested menus, used in web application's admin interface.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifier of the menu item.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier of the menu item.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL associated with the menu item.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the display order of the menu item.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the display order of the menu item.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with the menu.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the menu.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Returns the role associated with the menu.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Sets the role associated with the menu.
